meta.status: STRUCTURE CONFIRMED — PRICE MODIFIERS NOT CONFIRMED
meta.scope: These are UNPRICED finishing options only. Plate material and thickness are NOT here — they are priced variants on each product (see `variants` in products.json and the build ladder in meta.buildLadder). Duplicating them here produced two selectors on the product page, one of which silently did not change the price. Do not add material or thickness back to this file.
meta.warning: Every priceModifier below is 0 and every group is confirmed:false. The live-price mechanism on the product page is fully wired and working — it is simply adding zero until the client supplies real upcharges. Do not invent these numbers; a wrong upcharge is a mispriced order.
meta.howToConfirm: Set each priceModifier to the amount (in USD) that option adds to the base price, then set the group's confirmed to true. Negative values are allowed (e.g. Kids sizes below the adult base).
